implementation.hooks: prepare_prime_runtime_hooks.py adds RAII post-hooks to the translated 0x8017A4B4 (prologue 9421ffc0) and 0x801522E0 (9421ff30): PrimeMouseLookAfterTurn rewrites ctx->fpr[1] (turn factor) and sets +0x3C20 = 0.5; PrimeMouseLookAfterPitch writes +0x780.
implementation.model: runtime/include/hle/prime_mouse_look.h: TurnFactor(dx, radPerPixel, dt, turnSpeed) = clamp(-dx*rad/dt / speed) so the game's own angular velocity turns by the mouse delta each frame; PitchStep clamps to the game's limits; SurfaceMultiplierOffset mirrors 0x802E7058.
implementation.runtime: runtime/src/hle/input/prime_mouse_look.cpp: gate (enabled, focused, no host overlay, morph not 2/3, orbit not 1/3, aim-mode bit7 clear, not cinematic), turn speed read live from the tweaks, motion accumulator from SDL relative mode, Active() held 0.25 s after the last accepted frame; kpad.cpp centres the pointer while Active() and skips the Win32 cursor sampling while capturing; aurora_events.h services SDL_SetWindowRelativeMouseMode once per host frame.
implementation.options: Config.toml [prime] mouse_look (default true), mouse_look_sensitivity (deg per pixel, default 0.2, 0.02..1.0), mouse_look_invert_y; env WII_COMPILED_PRIME_MOUSE_LOOK=0/1; F1 > Controles; F6 shows 'Raton: camara (giro, cabeceo, velocidad de giro)'.
implementation.tests: mkw_prime_mouse_look_tests (turn factor sign/clamp/dt, pitch clamp/invert, surface table).

to_confirm_in_game: Yaw direction: mouse right must turn right (negative Z angular velocity assumed). If reversed, negate TurnFactor's omega.
Pitch sign: mouse up must look up (+0x780 positive assumed up). Otherwise flip the default of invert_y.
Turn speed units: the [prime-mouse-look] turn trace logs speed; if the camera turns far slower than the mouse asks, the tweak may be in degrees per second (then convert in TurnSpeed()).
Capture release in menus/map/ball/cinematics and recapture on return; cursor visible again for the pause menu.
limits: The maximum turn rate is the game's (factor clamped to 1): a very fast flick saturates at turnSpeed * surface multiplier of the chosen in-game sensitivity. The lock-on camera and all non-first-person states are untouched by design.

camera_rate_limit_fix_2026-10-25.symptom: After the easing bypass, the pitch still drifted briefly after the mouse stopped; yaw did not.
camera_rate_limit_fix_2026-10-25.cause: First-person camera think 0x8007F904 (4,420 bytes; callers 0x80080CE8/0x80080C44) reads CPlayer +0x77C (pitch) and +0x774 (free-look yaw) through getters 0x80080AE0/0x80080B0C, builds the look vector (sin/cos through the camera base pitch at camera +0x20C, clamped to +-1.562 rad), then updates its transform at camera +0x1DC in two legs: yaw = quaternion LookAt of the Z-flattened fronts with a 360-degree limit (FLOAT_8067F508, immediate), pitch = quaternion LookAt from the current front to the look vector limited to min(angle, dt * deg2rad(FLOAT_80682520) * CTweakPlayer +0x3BC (getter 0x802E6C4C) * clamp(1 - mapper +0x198 attenuation, 0..1) * (1 - CPlayer +0x6E4)). The actor transform is LookAt(eye, eye + front(+0x1DC)), and the gun follows that transform, so the rate limit is the residual inertia. Orbit branches use +0x2A4 (orbit 1/2) and +0x360 (orbit 3) instead and are outside the gate.
camera_rate_limit_fix_2026-10-25.frame_order: 0x801507D0 (player update) calls the pitch target 0x801522E0 before 0x8014F788 -> 0x8014F9F8 -> easing 0x80151F64; the camera think runs later in the frame, so +0x77C already equals the mouse pitch when the camera reads it.
camera_rate_limit_fix_2026-10-25.fix: Entry/exit hook on 0x8007F904 (prologue 9421f8b0): PrimeMouseLookCameraBegin substitutes 1.0e6 deg/s for CTweakPlayer +0x3BC when the pitch hook accepted mouse input this frame (g_cameraExact, set by PrimeMouseLookAfterPitch), PrimeMouseLookCameraEnd restores the original bits in the guard destructor. With that cap the game's own min() returns the exact angle (CameraPitchStep in the header reproduces the float arithmetic; unit-tested at 1/240..1/30 s). The attenuation factors stay the game's: if the game freezes the camera (attenuation 0) the mouse does not override it. No tweak value is changed outside the call.
camera_rate_limit_fix_2026-10-25.not_changed: Camera base pitch +0x20C, the clamps, the orbit/lock-on camera legs, the gun code 0x80186BD8 (uses GetFreeLookCurrentZ only for a tolerance test).
